subject: Re: Quick follow-up — two compact windows to schedule the deep dive

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khatri <samir@quantworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-08T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up — proposing two compact windows for the deep dive

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the discovery earlier. Apologies we didn't get to the deep dive portion — I know calendars got scrambled on both sides. To keep momentum, here are two compact windows that we'd like to hold for a focused technical deep dive with your engineering lead: 

- Tuesday, 2027-05-11 | 09:00–09:45 PT
- Thursday, 2027-05-13 | 11:00–11:45 PT

These are intentionally short (45m) to cover integration points, latency/throughput questions, and validation of your usage profile. If neither works, tell me two windows that do and I will do my best to align.

Ask: can you confirm one of the two by EOD Monday so we can lock engineering time? If we don't hear back, we'll release Tuesday's slot and propose alternatives.

Attached: compact agenda for the deep dive.

Thanks —
Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: deep-dive-agenda.pdf
From: Samir Khatri <samir@quantworks.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — proposing two compact windows for the deep dive

Hey Mina —

Sorry about the scramble on our side yesterday. We had an unexpected all-hands and Alex (our infra lead) was pulled into an urgent ops meeting. We definitely want the deep dive — we just need to make sure Alex (and possibly one more infra engineer) can join.

From our side these windows look close but I have a conflict on Thu 11:00 PT. Could we do either of the following instead?

- Wednesday, 2027-05-12 | 09:00–09:45 PT (preferred)
- Tuesday, 2027-05-11 | 13:00–13:45 PT (backup)

If we pick Wednesday, I'll add Alex (alex@quantworks.com) and cc him here. I know you mentioned a tight confirm policy — what happens if we can't lock within the window you suggested?

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Khatri
VP Product, QuantWorks
samir@quantworks.com

Samir —

Appreciate the heads-up. Wednesday 2027-05-12 09:00 PT works for us — Ben (cc'd) will be the technical owner on the call. If Alex can make it that'd be ideal.

Confirming logistics and policy: we try to hold the first suggested slot for 24 hours after we send options. If it's not confirmed in that window we release it and offer new times (we do this to protect engineering capacity). Given you asked for Wednesday, I'm happy to hold Thursday's 11:00 slot for backup but will release Tuesday 09:00 if we don't lock by EOD Monday.

I've added two quick actions to keep this tight: 
- Samir: reply to this thread with "CONFIRM — Wed 05/12 09:00 PT" to lock the slot (I'll send an invite)
- Samir: include Alex (or let me know his calendar availability)

I'll attach the agenda again and a short runbook for environment questions so Ben and Alex can triage in advance.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Mina
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Appreciate the tight cadence, Mina. See you both Wednesday.

Best,
Samir
